newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Sen Daschle sees no progress on taxes.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Sen Daschle sees no progress on taxes.

text.p: Senate Minority Leader Tom Daschle said Monday there had been no progress during weekend talks toward an agreement on tax cuts, and put the blame primarily on House Republican efforts to placate their more conservative members.
He told reporters, "We got nowhere" over the weekend in negotiations on the $85 billion tax cuts through 2002.

Daschle, a South Dakota Democrat, said the turmoil within the Republican party and discontent of conservative House members had influenced their leaders to "placate the far right." "That is not going to get us an agreement," he said.
